description: This file defines a repository class for accessing and manipulating root causes and 'five whys' analysis related data in a MongoDB database within a manufacturing defect management system. It includes methods for retrieving, updating, replacing, and listing root cause data and associated 'five whys' reasoning.

classes.name: RootCausesRepository
classes.description: Repository class for accessing root causes and why analysis collections in MongoDB.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the repository with references to the 'root_causes' and 'why_analysis' collections.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get_root_cause(self, defect_id)
methods.description: Retrieves a root cause document by defect ID.

methods.name: dict upsert_root_cause(self, defect_id, method: str, created_by)
methods.description: Inserts or updates a root cause entry for a given defect ID, recording method and timestamps.

methods.name: None replace_five_whys(self, defect_id, root_cause_id, whys: list[str])
methods.description: Deletes existing 'five whys' entries for a defect and inserts new ones based on provided list.

methods.name: list[dict] list_five_whys(self, defect_id)
methods.description: Lists all 'five whys' documents associated with a specific defect, sorted by level.

ctags.pattern: /^    def replace_five_whys(self, defect_id, root_cause_id, whys: list[str]) -> None:$/

ctags.pattern: /^    def upsert_root_cause(self, defect_id, method: str, created_by) -> dict:$/
